verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is a first-party serverless framework. It automatically runs backend code in response to background events, Firebase Authentication and Cloud Storage triggers, and Cloud Scheduler jobs, and deploys with one command. A community user also reports running production APIs solely on Functions. Missing for 10: any no-code or AI/agent-driven way to set up automations (code is required), and evidence of monitoring or retry controls for autonomous runs.
